name: Explainer video
description: A 30 second to 2 minute motion design explainer: script, style frames, animatic, final. Built in Remotion.

intake.label: What should the video explain?
intake.help: The idea, product or process, who it's for, and the one thing a viewer should remember.

intake.label: Narration
intake.help: Uses the studio's narration voice (Settings › Narration: ElevenLabs, or Qwen3-TTS on your own GPU). With none set up, the studio asks.

intake.label: Music
choices: Original score: I finish it from the MIDI (recommended)
intake.default: Original score: I finish it from the MIDI (recommended)
intake.help: The studio writes an original score in Strudel to the approved animatic and checks it against the picture. Recommended: you take its MIDI (every part on its own channel, with tempo and hit markers) into your own DAW, make the sound yours, and import the master. Or let Strudel render it.

intake.label: Your own script
intake.help: If you have one, it's spoken word for word.

steps.name: Brief
steps.describe: Restate the brief in plain words and ask the questions that change the video, each with a default.

steps.name: Style frames
steps.describe: Three to five finished-quality stills that fix the look. Runs beside the script.

steps.name: Transition board
steps.describe: How each style frame becomes the next: for every cut, the object that carries it, the reason, a transition from the remotion-transitions library (or a new one inspired by it), and real in-between frames.

steps.name: Animatic
steps.describe: Every beat timed to the narration with simple motion in the approved look. No music yet: the score is written to this timing next.

steps.name: Music
steps.describe: An original score written to the approved animatic: notes on MIDI channels, checked for harmony and hits on the frames that matter, with stand-in instruments so you can judge it against the picture. Then you finish it from the MIDI in your own DAW (recommended), or Strudel renders it.

status_lines.qc: Watching every frame before you do

checks.title: Every word, name and number is right
checks.how: Read every on-screen word and every script line against the brief and your sources. Names, numbers, units and spelling exactly right; nothing claimed that the brief or a source doesn't support.

checks.title: The script fits the length
checks.how: Spoken words at about 150 per minute (count them) land within 10% of the target length, with room for the holds.

checks.title: Text sits inside the title-safe area
checks.how: In every still and in sampled frames, every text box sits at least 5% inside each frame edge; nothing is cut off or touching an edge.

checks.title: Nothing collides by accident
checks.how: No text overlaps other text or a busy shape unless it's designed to; nothing is clipped by the frame or another layer.

checks.title: Text is readable
checks.how: Body text has at least 4.5:1 contrast with what's behind it at its worst frame; every text block stays on screen long enough to read twice (about words / 3 + 1 seconds).

checks.title: Every second looked at
checks.how: Run the final-pass skill's qc.mjs: no black, flash or frozen frames (unless designed), and look at its contact sheet (a frame per second) yourself. Every sampled frame makes visual sense.

checks.title: The right size, rate and length
checks.how: ffprobe (qc.mjs) shows the brief's shape at 1080p or more, a constant frame rate, H.264 + AAC, and a duration within 5% of the target.

checks.title: Loudness and no clipping
checks.how: qc.mjs: integrated loudness -14 LUFS (±1) for web, true peak at or below -1 dBTP, no clicks, pops or distortion when you listen through.

checks.title: Picture and sound in sync
checks.how: Each spoken key word lands with its visual within 2 frames (check against the word timings); music hits land on cuts they were meant for.

checks.title: The score passes its check
checks.how: node .claude/skills/music/strudel.mjs check --video-sec <length> --fps <fps> ends with 0 problems (harmony locked to the chart, every hit within a frame of its picture moment, nothing playing past the end, every role playing, the intensity curve following the sections' asks) and captured the MIDI (music/notes.json, out/music/midi/).

checks.title: Every channel has an instrument that fits it
checks.how: The score holds only notes; node .claude/skills/music/strudel.mjs instruments and audition pass: every channel covered, no two parts in one register with the same timbre, no part silent or clipping across its range.

checks.title: The music is the right master
checks.how: When the brief says the owner finishes the music from the MIDI, the mix uses music/own-master/master.wav (strudel.mjs own-master passes) and its warnings are answered in the note; otherwise the approved Strudel render. n/a with a reason on steps before the music.

checks.title: The music sits under the voice
checks.how: In the mix, the music is about 18 dB under the voice while it speaks (sidechain ducking), and the score's busiest writing avoids the narration's busiest moments. Every word stays intelligible: check the loudest music passage under speech.

checks.title: Every cut is carried and chosen
checks.how: node .claude/skills/transition-board/board.mjs check passes: every cut names its carrier (the object or element that makes it happen) and why, uses a transition from the remotion-transitions library (or a new one that names the library transitions that inspired it) at a length inside its range, and lands on a named word. The video's cuts match the approved board.
